protocol.distribution: todayOrders records today and 130 per historical Shanghai business day; every third record initially served; unique ids; initial server version 1 (C04 old-version target starts at 2)
protocol.action: C01 local domain toggle/store write/views then simulated server confirmation/views; C02-C04 actual store methods/views; C05 isolated actual optimistic journal and store delivery interleavings/views

boundaries.totalMs: synchronous operation sequence entry to final count/all-list derivation completion
boundaries.storeCommitMs: synchronous target store methods; C01 also includes domain toggle and confirmation payload construction
boundaries.journalMs: actual begin/end/record journal methods, only where exercised
boundaries.reset: fixture generation, store reset/injection and initial derivation excluded before every warmup and sample

protocol.aggregation: mean of five equally weighted trial means; five measured operations per case per trial
excludes: WebSocket decoding, rAF queue waiting and pre-store hook deduplication/tombstones
localStorage disk I/O (isolated memory storage only)
actual request promises, hook callbacks, snapshot reconciliation and 300 ms duplicate-tap guard
fixture generation, reset, initial derivation and correctness assertions
